_comment: Editable vocabulary for backend/app/standard_ids.py, the one matcher for
standard identifiers (#452). Code holds only the SHAPE of an identifier
(issuing body, optional series, whole number, optional part or division,
year ignored). Every equivalence between names lives here, so an engineer
can add one without a code change. Entries are read once and cached.
equivalent: each list names ONE standard several ways. Every entry is
written as an identifier the matcher itself can read; the first entry is
the canonical name. A part or year written here is ignored - the whole
standard is equivalent, and its parts must still agree.
body_aliases: an issuing-body prefix (as the general pattern reads it,
upper case) mapped to the body it adopts. A national adoption of a
European standard is the same standard: BS EN 13445 is EN 13445.
api_document_words: words written between "API" and the number that are
not part of the identity: API RP 520, API Std 520, API Spec 520 are all
